schema: iri index-file comparison v1 (produced by iri_index_checks.py, this directory)

installed.source: iricore-1.8.0-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_35_x86_64.whl, PyPI, sha256 f452b22316891d87ee766dba266de6a07e4e6008ab515ffed902ea8b5446a874 (uploaded 2024-04-02); member iricore/data/index/; hashes equal to those the Kaggle run reported

ig_rz.dat.required_month_values_note: per-month IG12/Rz12 values are not enumerated here (locked-month custody guard R-26); read them from index_files/ with iri_index_checks.parse_ig_rz

historical.source: GitHub master snapshot at commit 92c6d8c727b0300d8bd61e7e8e91dd97514256a7 (archive retained from the 2026-09-19 session, sha256 03d8973b6b08c7ef16cb2ea1556509ff2ae9eba3e868fa500bc45f87b69c8e28) and PyPI sdist iricore-1.9.0.tar.gz (sha256 6f1503716f5f8ba3e48038a4cade9310d396ee2dce299ac841824a054b595e35, matches PyPI); both carry byte-identical index files; these are the copies CR-2026-09-19-SCI-DECISIONS section 3 inspected

conclusion: every apf107.dat row and ig_rz.dat month that IRI-2016 (iricore 1.8.0 compiled irifun.for: APF, APF_ONLY, tcon) reads for any 2022 target time, and every window behind the centered columns those rows carry, is identical between the installed and the historical files; differences begin 2023-09-08 (apf107) / 2023-09 (ig_rz), outside every such window
not_claimed: no performance effect measured or claimed; provider observed/provisional grade of the underlying monthly data is not encoded in the files and is not asserted

custody_statement.policy: D-48 (December custody scan) and R-26/R-27; project.md December-blind rule
custody_statement.content: index-file (driver) metadata only: file hashes, row/month counts, coverage bounds stated as [first, end_exclusive) / [first, last, count] intervals, recomputation residuals, and value-difference dates between two file versions. No target value, prediction, metric, or per-day/per-month index VALUE for any 2022 month is stored here. A first version of this file (2026-09-19, overwritten, hash not retained) enumerated the 14 required months with their IG12/Rz12 values, including the locked month's; those values were removed because the report does not need them, not to defeat the scanner -- the scanner had correctly flagged that version and the flag is recorded in CR-2026-09-19-SCI-DECISIONS-P3 3.8.3.
custody_statement.interval_semantics: direct_read_rows_required = [2021-12-30, 2023-01-01) = 367 daily rows (the two ap-history days before the year plus every day of the year); months_required = 2021-12 .. 2023-01 inclusive = 14 months; both asserted by evidence/iri2016_kaggle_verification_2026-09-19/validation/test_modules.py
custody_statement.exposure: D-48 item 4 disclosure: to compare the installed and historical files, every apf107.dat row and every ig_rz.dat month -- including those of December 2022 -- was read and compared for equality (driver indices: adjusted F10.7, ap, IG12, Rz12). No December value was inspected for a target, prediction, threshold, lag, missingness or model decision; the reading served version identification only. This is exposure to December DRIVER indices, of the same class the custody scan already excludes (classes 1-5), never to December targets.
custody_statement.scanner_note: the JSON detector is literal/structural (D-48 item 1); an interval stated with an exclusive bound carries no literal and is not detected. That is a documented limit of the detector, not a compliance mechanism: this file is compliant because it carries no December datum, and it is listed here so a reviewer can verify that claim directly.
